Bill.BriefDescription: Providing excise tax relief for public development authorities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to excise tax relief for public developmentauthorities; and adding a new section to chapter 82.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to public development authoritiescreated under RCW 35.21.660 or 35.21.730 through 35.21.755 in respectto amounts derived from providing services to: (1) A limited liability company in which the public developmentauthority is the sole managing member; (2) A limited partnership in which the public development authorityis the sole general partner; or (3) A single asset entity required under any federal, state, orlocal governmental housing assistance program, which is controlleddirectly or indirectly by the public development authority.
